correctness.rationale: For connected K_{a1,...,ak} with k>=3 and n>=3, P=conv{±(e_u-e_v)} lies in full (n-1)-dimensional H; central symmetry makes 0 an incenter (not necessarily unique). A facet at <f,x>=1 has projected H-normal f-mean(f)1, so distance 1/sqrt(n sum f_i²-(sum f_i)² over n). Higashitani--Jochemko--Michałek 2018 Proposition 3.5 yields exactly type I: one nonsingleton part ±1 with both signs, outside 0; type II: 0/1 with part-constant patterns or at least two split parts. Type I squared-normal maximum per size a>=2 is a-(a mod 2)/n. Type II maximum bounded by floor(n²/4)/n, attainable whenever it can dominate the type-I maximum; if balanced labels fail for the sole nonsingleton part, then that part is >n/2 and its type-I maximum strictly dominates C_n. All singleton parts have no type I and do realize balanced type II. Equality contact families therefore follow exactly from norm maximizers. Direct independent exact-rational enumeration of all qualifying 67 unordered multipartitions for n=3..9, with source Prop 3.5 facet-type tests, reproduced predicted maxima and type-contact sets; this finite corroboration is not the universal proof. No reliance on VERIFY_OK or old PASS.
